title: run_sse SSE buffer has no size limit
description: client.rs run_sse accumulates incoming bytes in a single String buf (line 247). The buffer is only drained when a double-newline boundary is found. A misbehaving or malicious kithd that never sends a blank line will grow buf without bound until OOM. No byte limit is enforced. Trigger: continuous SSE stream without blank-line boundary causes unbounded memory growth in the TUI process.
